categories.main_business_segments: Optorun operates a single business segment focused on the manufacturing and sales of optical thin-film deposition equipment. These systems are used to apply functional coatings to optical components found in products such as smartphones, cameras, automotive sensors, LED devices, AR/VR equipment, and optical communication modules.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include ion beam assisted evaporation, sputtering, reactive plasma deposition, and atomic layer deposition (ALD). These methods enable the formation of advanced thin films with functions such as anti-reflection, IR-cut, bandpass filtering, and protective coatings, tailored for high-performance optical and electronic devices.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Optorun's main customers are manufacturers of optical thin-film components and end-product makers in industries such as consumer electronics (smartphones, tablets), automotive (cameras, sensors, displays), LED lighting, AR/VR, and optical communications. Major clients include leading optical component suppliers like Largan Precision and Zhejiang Sunny Optics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with key operations in Japan, China, and Taiwan, and additional presence in the US, Vietnam, and Finland. The majority of sales are to customers in China and Taiwan, with growing activities in Southeast Asia and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Optorun is positioned as an upstream equipment supplier, providing deposition systems and process solutions to component manufacturers and device makers. It also offers process consulting and after-sales services, and has some involvement in parts processing and thin-film processing through affiliates.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, Optorun aims to expand from optical to semiconductor-optical fusion and electronic device markets, emphasizing R&D in advanced deposition technologies (including ALD and etching) and process innovation. The company prioritizes global supply chain resilience, cross-regional R&D collaboration, and partnerships/M&A to acquire new technologies, with a focus on high-growth areas such as automotive, AR/VR, and green energy devices.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of custom-built deposition equipment, with additional income from process consulting, after-sales maintenance, and parts sales. Revenue recognition occurs upon customer acceptance of delivered equipment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Optorun is a leading global supplier in the optical thin-film equipment sector, competing with Japanese, Chinese, and European manufacturers. The company differentiates itself through advanced technology, process know-how, and strong customer relationships, but faces intense competition and price pressure in a rapidly evolving market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2024, Optorun reported consolidated net sales of approximately 32.4 billion yen, with an operating profit of 6.57 billion yen and net income attributable to shareholders of 6.35 billion yen. While sales declined year-on-year due to lower shipment volumes, profitability improved due to favorable product mix and forex gains. The company maintains a strong equity ratio (72.1%) and targets medium-term growth, aiming for 80 billion yen in sales and 25% operating margin by 2030.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Optorun delivers value through its advanced thin-film deposition technologies, deep process expertise, and ability to provide total solutions tailored to diverse customer needs. Its differentiation lies in offering high-performance, customizable equipment and process support that enable customers to achieve superior optical and electronic device functionality, supporting innovation in fast-evolving end markets.
